scope: Corollary 4.5 (The two body roles) of the manuscript “Polynomial removal fails for ordered binary matrices” (preprints/Polynomial-removal-fails-for-ordered-binary-matrices-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 190 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 120f7749fe55baa4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In every ordered copy of H in Ah, the first 64 rows and columns are anchor representatives of one mode t. Its two body rows belong respectively to R1(t), R2(t), and its two body columns belong respectively to C1(t), C2(t).
